composition_subtypes.role: Iteratively computes reachable XOR values from subsets

payload.core_composition_summary: A single DP loop that expands a set of reachable XOR values by XORing with each array element, tracking the maximum.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a single iterative state expansion (DP) with a set to avoid duplicates. No coordinated multi-mechanism; XOR is inherent to the problem, not an extra algorithm.
